product.detailed_description: Skittles Fruits Vegan Chewy Sweets are a colourful mix of chewy sweets with a crisp sugar shell. Each 136 g bag brings an unexpected, bold fruit flavoured experience to your day. These fruit sweets are designed for those looking for an unconventional, playful escape from the everyday. - A vibrant mix of fruit flavoured sweets in a crisp sugar shell. - Each 136 g bag of Skittles offers a bold and colourful experience. - Perfect for sharing during a relaxed evening. - Suitable for vegetarians.
